infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your camera to take a profile picture, record video proof of your playing level (for example, filming yourself during a rally to verify your skill rating), and scan invite QR codes to join groups, communities, or matches.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your photo library to set a player, group, or community profile picture and to submit rating proof, for example selecting a video of your gameplay to verify your skill level.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your contacts to import them into shared lists, send SMS invitations, and select match opponents, for example inviting a friend to play via text message.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your location to show nearby courts and facilities sorted by distance, for example "Tennis Club 0.3 km away".
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your location to show nearby courts and facilities sorted by distance, for example "Tennis Club 0.3 km away".
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your location to show nearby courts and facilities sorted by distance, for example "Tennis Club 0.3 km away".
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses your microphone to capture audio when recording video proof of your playing level, for example recording the sound during a rally video.
